params.name: CampaignId
params.description: The ID of the campaign (program) to view action inquiries for.

params.name: StartDate
params.description: Filters for inquiries created on or after this date (ISO 8601).

params.name: EndDate
params.description: Filters for inquiries created on or before this date (ISO 8601).

params.name: TransactionDateStart
params.description: Filters for inquiries with a transaction date on or after this value.

params.name: TransactionDateEnd
params.description: Filters for inquiries with a transaction date on or before this value.

params.name: MediaPartnerId
params.description: Filters inquiries to a specific partner by their ID.

params.name: OrderId
params.description: Filters for inquiries associated with a specific order ID.

params.name: ResolutionStatus
params.description: Filters inquiries by their resolution status.

items.docs: Returns a list of the action inquiries made for your campaign, filtered by the provided parameters. The inquiries are returned by creation date, with the most recent appearing first.
Updates an action inquiry by setting its resolution status and other related parameters.

params.name: InquiryId
params.description: The unique identifier for the action inquiry.

items.docs: Retrieves the details of an existing action inquiry by its unique ID.
